integrity: The proof is an analytic transposition-balancing argument with equality rigidity, supplemented by reproducible finite checks. Finite assertions are not used to prove the unbounded-parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: Complete square-free homogeneous Steinhaus Fourier layers on continuous complex tori only; no assertion for Walsh signs, other support families, or moments other than the fourth. No external priority certification.
title: Sharp fourth moments and phase rigidity of all square-free Fourier layers
